title: Magnet not as strong as my larger Mag bar..
text:
Magnet not as strong as my larger Mag bar... I have allot of knifes, and my Magnetic larger medal knife holder is filled up.
Thought I would like this wood magnetic knife strip, as I like the wood look, and a it’s a good price.

My husband installed this in the kitchen, and found the holes in the back for hanging are Not even! ( this was not
Going good!) it took him about one hour or longer to hung this.
Finally got it on the wall, and when I started to put my knifes on it , I noticed the lower part of this magnetic
Bar was not as strong as the upper part of the bar, . Also My other older metal bar’s magnet is allot stronger.

On this smaller Mag Bar I’m only hanging my lighter smaller knifes on it. A bit disappointing.!

Btw, when putting your knifes on a magnetic bar , put the tip of the knifes up with the handles on the bottom.

3 stars, magnet is not as strong, and the hanging holes are not even.
